finding.title: Buffer Overflow
finding.trigger: if the input id is exactly 2 characters long, strncpy will copy 2 characters and the null terminator will be explicitly set, but if id is longer, the null terminator will not be set properly.
finding.assumptions: The input id is not validated to be exactly 2 characters long.

parsed.refutation_attempt: Reviewed the copy size and explicit null termination. The call to strncpy copies at most 2 bytes into a 3-byte buffer and then sets the last byte (_id[2]) to '\0', ensuring that the destination never receives more than its allocated size. No unchecked write can occur on the destination buffer. The only potential issue would be reading beyond the source buffer if the caller passes a too-small buffer, but that is not a buffer overflow of the destination and is outside the responsibility of this function.
